history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) are under grave threat due to the drastic reduction of sea ice, which they rely on for hunting seals. As the Arctic warms at an alarming rate—twice the global average—the IUCN and Arctic scientists warn that the loss of this crucial habitat is the primary long-term danger to their survival. While some subpopulations may appear stable, this is a misleading snapshot that ignores their fundamental dependence on ice. As ice-free seasons lengthen, we can expect increased fasting and lower cub survival, particularly in southern regions. It's crucial to recognize that polar bear populations are not simply a singular global count; they vary by management units. Additional pressures such as conservation hunting quotas and pollution only exacerbate the impact of sea-ice loss. Claims that polar bears are thriving due to chemtrails or that global warming is a hoax because of one stable subpopulation are unfounded and misleading. We must remain vigilant against the hidden agendas that distort the truth. #depopulation #nwo #chemtrails #geoengineering
